successCriteria.description: LeaveType enum in src/shared/types/index.ts contains all six values: ANNUAL, SICK, EMERGENCY, UNPAID, MATERNITY, PATERNITY — matching ARCHITECTURE.md canonical definition exactly.
LeaveRequestStatus enum in src/shared/types/index.ts contains DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED — PENDING is removed entirely. Matches ARCHITECTURE.md lifecycle states for LeaveRequest.
EmployeeStatus enum in src/shared/types/index.ts contains ACTIVE, INACTIVE, TERMINATED — ON_LEAVE is removed. Matches ARCHITECTURE.md Employee lifecycle states.
Jest unit tests in tests/unit/shared/ pass and validate the new enum values: LeaveType has 6 members, LeaveRequestStatus has 5 members (no PENDING), EmployeeStatus has 3 members (no ON_LEAVE).

constraints: Enum values must exactly match the canonical definitions in ARCHITECTURE.md — no additional, missing, or differently-named members.
The string literal values assigned to each enum member must match the member name exactly (e.g., UNPAID = 'UNPAID', not UNPAID = 'unpaid').
outOfScope: Updating downstream consumers of these enums (employee module, policy module, leave module, balance module, or any other file that imports from src/shared/types/index.ts) to reflect the changed enum values.
Updating PLAN.md to reflect the corrected enum values (PLAN.md still references the old PENDING and ON_LEAVE values from the original Phase 1 spec).
